title: The oplax mate of a lax monoidal right adjoint
statement:
Let $\mathcal C,\mathcal D$ be categories [def-nagata-category] equipped with monoidal structures [def-sfb-monoidal-category], that is, tensor bifunctors, unit objects $\mathbf 1_{\mathcal C},\mathbf 1_{\mathcal D}$, and natural associator and left and right unitor isomorphisms satisfying the pentagon and triangle identities. Let $L:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$ and $R:\mathcal D\to\mathcal C$ be functors (preserving identities and compositions), and let $L\dashv R$ be an adjunction with natural Hom bijections $\Phi_{X,V}:\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal D}(LX,V)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal C}(X,RV)$ and unit $u_X=\Phi_{X,LX}(\mathrm{id}_{LX})$. Give $R$ a lax monoidal structure: a map $e:\mathbf 1_{\mathcal C}\to R\mathbf 1_{\mathcal D}$ and natural maps $m_{V,W}:RV\otimes RW\to R(V\otimes W)$ satisfying the associativity and the two unit compatibility identities. Then the maps
$$
 d_0=\Phi_{\mathbf 1_{\mathcal C},\mathbf 1_{\mathcal D}}^{-1}(e),\qquad
 d_{X,Y}=\Phi_{X\otimes Y,LX\otimes LY}^{-1}\bigl(m_{LX,LY}\circ(u_X\otimes u_Y)\bigr)
$$
make $L$ oplax monoidal: $d_0:L\mathbf 1_{\mathcal C}\to\mathbf 1_{\mathcal D}$ and $d_{X,Y}:L(X\otimes Y)\to LX\otimes LY$ are natural and satisfy the associativity and the two unit compatibility identities in the reversed directions.
